setupSubtitle: Choose role and connect to Wi-Fi
controllerDescription: Needs to be connected to the internet to send data to the server. Serves as an access point for workers. Needs a constant power source.
workerDescription: Connects to the mesh network to provide sensor data. Sends data to the controller. Can be battery powered.
